newsitem.title: USA: Sonat says Texas well likely significant.
newsitem.headline: Sonat says Texas well likely significant.

text.p: Sonat Inc said Thursday that a well currently being completed may be its most significant exploratory success so far.
The Blanton No. 1 well is in East Texas. The company's projection is based on a preliminary analysis of the site.

The company has a 100 percent working interest in the Blanton No. 1, which is in the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef. It has a second well, Scurlock No. 1, and plans to increase its activity there to at least three rigs in early 1997.
